name: read-the-game
description: Zero dependencies, deliberately. `npm test` runs node's built-in runner.

scripts.build: export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; node builders/learn-doors.mjs >/dev/null && python3 builders/build_main.py && python3 builders/build_main.py --verify && python3 builders/build_index.py && python3 builders/build_index.py --verify && npm run build:rest
scripts.build:rest: export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; for b in build_A build_B build_C build_gv build_3d; do python3 builders/$b.py >/dev/null || exit 1; done
scripts.build:check: npm run build >/dev/null && git diff --quiet -- src/ data/learn-doors.json || (echo 'STALE: a built page in src/ or data/learn-doors.json differs from a fresh build — page.py or a layer changed and someone rebuilt only part of the site' && git --no-pager diff --stat -- src/ data/learn-doors.json && exit 1)
scripts.gates: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:py && npm run refcheck && npm run health -- --check && npm run extract:verify && npm run extract:validate && npm run extract:vocab && npm run build
